metadata.initiative: 06 — GitHub Action, GitHub App, and Integration Layer

assignments.title: Define Action specifications and output format
assignments.reason: Specification design requires planning capability to define all checks, inputs, and outputs before any code is written
constraints: Must produce unambiguous spec that both INFRA tasks can implement independently

assignments.title: Set up skillweave-action-validate repository
assignments.reason: Repository scaffolding requires infrastructure setup and code generation for action.yml, CI workflow, and README
constraints: Repository must be separate from core SkillWeave repo
Must include CI workflow that validates the Action

assignments.title: Implement bundle validation logic
assignments.reason: Core validation engine requires code generation for directory traversal, schema validation, reference checking, and JSON output

assignments.title: Set up skillweave-action-release-check repository
assignments.reason: Repository scaffolding for second Action, parallel to INFRA-001; same infrastructure pattern
constraints: Repository must be separate from core SkillWeave repo
Must include CI workflow that validates the Action

assignments.title: Implement release readiness check logic
assignments.reason: Release readiness engine requires code generation for version comparison, changelog parsing, test detection, and WIP marker scanning
constraints: Must compare version against previous release tag
PR merge blocking as status check is optional but designed for

assignments.title: Implement trust signal generation
assignments.reason: Badge generation, release asset attachment, and attestation-ready output require code generation with GitHub API integration
constraints: Output must support future supply chain signing

assignments.title: GitHub App feasibility assessment
assignments.reason: Assessment requires strategic planning capability to evaluate build cost, maintenance burden, and user value across 4 use cases
constraints: Must cover all 4 use cases: repo sync, release signals, trust, discovery

assignments.title: Test Actions on SkillWeave repository
assignments.reason: End-to-end testing of both Actions against real SkillWeave bundle data requires testing capability and the SkillWeave repo as test target
constraints: Must test against actual SkillWeave repo
Must verify no false positives on known-good structure
Must verify false negatives on intentionally broken structure

assignments.title: Prepare Actions for distribution
assignments.reason: Version tagging, dist/ building, and marketplace preparation require infrastructure and code_generation capabilities
constraints: Both Actions must be tagged v1.0.0 and v1
dist/ folder must be built and committed

parallel_groups.description: Track A and Track B run in parallel after DESIGN-001 completes
Trust signal generation and GitHub App assessment run in parallel after both tracks complete

agent_continuity_rules: DESIGN-001 agent must hand off complete spec before Track A/Track B agents begin
FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 can be assigned to different agents since repos are independent
TEST-001 agent must have access to both Action repos and the SkillWeave repo
DIST-001 agent must coordinate both repos for synchronized version tagging
